senses.zh_definition: 莱迪斯：专有姓氏，可见于《禁闭岛》人物名 Andrew Laeddis；不是已证实的马来语普通词。
senses.en_definition: A proper surname, notably that of Andrew Laeddis in Shutter Island.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga, khususnya dalam nama watak Andrew Laeddis dalam Shutter Island; bukan kata nama am bahasa Melayu yang disahkan.
senses.nuances: noun 在此兼容表示专有名词。输入没有原始语境，因此与《禁闭岛》人物的对应是有文献依据的候选识别，不能保证就是原语料所指。马来语释义为编写说明，并非 DBP 官方定义。下列是名称组合及说明性短语，未经语料频率验证。[《禁闭岛》剧本](https://assets.scriptslug.com/live/pdf/scripts/shutter-island-2010.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: Laeddis is encountered as a character surname in Shutter Island, whose screenplay identifies Dennis Lehane's novel as its source. That literary occurrence establishes a referent, not a Malay lexical meaning or a historical derivation of the surname. Without the original corpus passage, identifying this particular token with that character remains a contextual inference. [Screenplay](https://assets.scriptslug.com/live/pdf/scripts/shutter-island-2010.pdf)
